entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry this was kinda sudden. I know it's[n]cramped, but make yourself at home.
What's the plan today?
Why did we come here?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, I didn't call you here for anything[n]big or official...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I just figure we've gotten to know each[n]other pretty well, so hey, why not hang[n]out at home! Or something. Eheheh...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Sorry.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Actually... I wanted to give you a[n]proper apology for everything.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know. 'Cause I got caught up in[n]the life Dr. Maruki made for me.
That's in the past.
It's okay, I get it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess, but...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even if you're okay with it, it's really[n]been bothering me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, even if it didn't bother you...[n]it's been on my mind.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Honestly, I'm still trying to figure[n]out what the right choice is.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, I'm not saying Dr. Maruki's[n]reality is better or anything...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But I can't stop thinking about Shiho.[n]Or how great her life could've been[n]if things were like this.
I know the feeling.
Do you regret our choice?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Thanks. Don't worry—I'm still gonna[n]fight back against Dr. Maruki.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: His world could make a lot of people[n]happy, sure, but... does that really give[n]him the right to change reality?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No. Not at all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I know this isn't actually reality.[n]I would've been happy, sure, but...[n]it wouldn't have been real.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shiho was still moving forward. Even[n]after everything she'd been through,[n]she didn't lose hope.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: My strength came from her. That's why,[n]when Kamoshida said he'd kill himself,[n]I told him he couldn't run from it all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She didn't run away, so he can't either.[n]And if I took the easy way out now...[n]I'd be letting Shiho down.
You're right.
Don't force yourself...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're so kind, [fName].

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Kinda familiar, huh? Back when I[n]finally broke down under the Kamoshida[n]stuff, you listened to me like this too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You didn't know me at all, but you[n]still listened to everything.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I couldn't figure you out. Like, I kept[n]thinking, "What is this guy's deal?"

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Not only that, but you helped me with[n]Shiho and my modeling...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're too nice for your own good.
My bad.
Anything for you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No, no, I should be apologizing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm actually really grateful. But... that[n]kind of makes me feel even worse[n]about all this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Eheh, I get it. Can't stand a sad face[n]on a pretty girl, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway... I really am grateful. But that[n]just makes me feel even worse about[n]accepting this reality.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm never going to lose my way again.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: From now on, I'm going to face reality.[n]For me, for Shiho... and for you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is this... my power? I can't believe it...
Ann's Persona [clr 1]Hecate[clr 27] has transformed[n]into [clr 2]Célestine[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay, I'm ready to move on! Thank you[n]for everything!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I promise, I'm gonna do even better[n]from here on out!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All right. I'll see you later!
